_comment: ARM 37 — SPEC_level_information_budget §17 item 1, STAGE 2 (3 h), earned by §23's
stage-1 PASS at the current mask denominator.  LV-4 alone (network.rx_cb_carry_step_gate);
de-mean OFF so the loader forces LV-5 off (GnssConfigLoadNetwork.cpp:6630); LV-1 OFF.
Fresh SEAMLESS lineage from day start, own paths, never resumed onto another arm's
snapshot (staged-escalation directive, 2026-08-05).
CONTROL: arm 32, runs/ext63_dual_3h_m15i25 (obs 15 / iono 25, 3 h), SAME 00:09 build,
ONE knob apart.  Both arms run obs mask 15, so the identical-observations control holds
within the pair (arm 32: 132967-class phase obs at h2-3 scale; §23.1 measured 78931 in
the matched 1 h window).  Any large obs-count deviation means a second variable is loose.
WHY STAGE 2 EXISTS.  §23.1 passed all five §17 stage-1 gates at 15/25 (folds 98.9 %,
erases 0.25 %, sd 1.42, no alternation, sh_health 0/0/0), which un-falsifies §19's
stage-1 kill and earns the 3 h stage per the escalation directive.  Both open questions
are ones a 1 h window cannot answer (§14: the level channel's convergence budget is
~2 h): (a) does LV-4's +35 % data-side cost persist into the settled h2-3 window, and
(b) does the level hold the band once past ignition, or walk the way §15 measured the
12 h stack walking.
PREDICTIONS, STATED BEFORE THE RUN:
1. DATA SIDE (the invariant-legal GRADE, §19.6): the cost PERSISTS settled.  Predict
measured +44 % at h2-3 and +40 % over 12 h at obs 10; arm 34 measured +35 % settled
at 1 h at obs 15.  Basis: the mechanism (full admission delivers carry information
the observations do not support) is not a transient — the 12 h stack never shed it.
2. LEVEL (DIAGNOSTIC only, invariant #5): h2-3 time-matched a00-GIM(t) stays inside
the §17 stage-2 band (within ±4..9 TECU of zero) and ABOVE the control (less
negative) by +2..6 TECU, extending §23.1's sign inversion (LV-4 at 15/25 lifted the
level +4.7 at h0).  Breathing sd ≤ the control's 4.42.  The interesting failure
mode to watch: a RAMP — §14 saw the pinned stack ramp +15..+21 after hour 2; LV-4's
full admission feeds the rolling memory 2.2x as fast as the control's 44 %, so if
admitted-mass drives any slow walk it should show FIRST here.
3. MECHANICS: folds ≥ 98 %, erases ≤ 0.5 %, sh_health 0/0/0, no 3-epoch alternation
(all passed at 1 h and none is window-sensitive in the harmful direction).
4. AUDIT FEEDS (§13.5 / §23.4, armed below): prires rxcb sigma0 3-6x the control's
(arm 34 read 3.11 vs 0.63); congruence sigma0 LOWER than the control's (the §23.4
split, still unexplained — record, don't verdict); block-Baarda partially unfloored
at 3 h (36 % floored at 12 h, 100 % at 1 h) — FIRST usable read on an LV-4 pair:
record which side of the over-retention trade it lands on.
STAGE-2 GATE (§17 item 1): pass = P2's band + P3 + no over-retention signature
(data-side sigma0 inflating while prior side quiets).  NOTE even a full pass does NOT
promote — §23's verdict stands (LV-4 costs the data side in every cell measured); a
pass buys the 12 h stage-3 run for the record, nothing else.  A P1 miss (cost gone
settled) would be the surprise that re-opens promotion.
KNOWN instrument holes (§19.4, re-verified §23.4): network_prior_residual.csv emits
ONLY the rxcb family under this posture; network_pf_keyed.csv has n_code == 0 in every
row (code-side reads vacuous).  Usable data-side instruments: rms_phase / s0_phase
from pf_keyed, congruence sigma0, and (3 h, partially) block-Baarda.
